system_description.narrative_title: Trump’s Kim outreach and drill cuts destabilize East Asian security
system_description.narrative_summary: The dominant narrative links President Trump’s push to meet Kim Jong Un and his orders to scale back U.S.-South Korea military drills with a spike in regional instability: North Korea’s dismissals and missile launches, South Korean alarm, and shifting alliance dynamics. Treated as an open system, the story highlights flows and feedbacks between diplomatic signaling, military posture (drills, deployments, provocation), alliance credibility, and regional actors’ countermeasures — with China’s strategic moves and economic signals interacting as influential inputs. These interactions produce reinforcing and balancing feedbacks (e.g., drill cuts → perceived weakening of deterrence → DPRK tests → alliance unease → pressure on US policy), and they are coupled to economic levers (investment, sanctions, fiscal policy) that modulate state behavior.
system_description.scope: Security-diplomatic subsystem of Northeast Asia: U.S. presidency and its policy signals toward DPRK; DPRK leadership responses (diplomacy, missile tests); ROK (Seoul) political and security reactions; trilateral military activity (U.S.-ROK drills); China's regional diplomacy and maritime activity; Japan and Taiwan security responses; economic signals from China that affect strategic calculations (investment, fiscal moves).
system_description.super_system: Global great-power competition and the international economic order (U.S.-China-Russia strategic rivalry embedded in global governance, trade and capital flows).
adjacent_subsystems: China's domestic economy and fiscal/industrial policy
U.S. domestic politics and presidential strategy
Taiwan cross-strait tensions and defense planning

variables.name: Diplomatic signal flow
variables.description: The rate and visibility of official diplomatic offers, invitations, and public outreach between state actors in the region.

variables.name: Military drill scope
variables.description: The aggregate scale, duration, and scope of joint and unilateral military exercises conducted in the theater.

variables.name: Deterrence credibility
variables.description: The perceived reliability and effectiveness of deterrent commitments as judged by regional actors and adversaries.

variables.name: Provocative military action rate
variables.description: The frequency of coercive or provocative military acts such as missile launches, border incursions, or explicit threats.

variables.name: Alliance cohesion level
variables.description: The degree of political and operational alignment among allied partners over shared security objectives and responses.

variables.name: Defense posture flexibility
variables.description: The capacity to reconfigure force posture, deployments, and operational plans in response to changing threats or diplomacy.

variables.name: Economic leverage pressure
variables.description: The intensity of economic measures and signals (trade, investment, fiscal moves) used to influence regional strategic behavior.

variables.name: Foreign capital flow
variables.description: The net inflow or outflow of cross-border investment and private capital into regional economies affecting political-economic stability.

variables.name: Sanctions and constraints intensity
variables.description: The severity and breadth of economic sanctions, trade restrictions, and financial constraints applied to target actors.

variables.name: Domestic political pressure
variables.description: The level of internal political demand on leaderships to take hawkish or dovish stances toward regional security issues.

variables.name: Maritime activity flow
variables.description: The tempo and concurrency of naval patrols, construction, and maritime operations in contested waters.

variables.name: Crisis escalation propensity
variables.description: The systemic tendency for incidents or signals to cascade into higher-intensity confrontations or armed conflict.

variables.name: Communications channel clarity
variables.description: The reliability, transparency, and procedural clarity of diplomatic and military lines of communication between actors.

variables.name: Defense spending trend
variables.description: The rate of change in defense budget allocations and procurement trajectories across regional actors.

variables.name: Great-power rivalry pressure
variables.description: The background intensity of strategic competition among major powers that shapes regional incentives and risks.

variables.name: Military readiness level
variables.description: The overall preparedness of armed forces to mobilize, deploy, and operate effectively on short notice.

catalysts.title: Potential Trump–Kim summit
catalysts.description: U.S. push for a meeting between Donald Trump and Kim Jong Un this year that could materialize as a summit or preparatory talks.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Trump says he plans to meet...'; 'Trump pushes for Kim meeting this year'; North Korea dismisses overture.

catalysts.title: US–South Korea drill reductions
catalysts.description: Implementation of orders to shorten, halve or otherwise reduce the scope and duration of joint US–ROK military exercises.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Trump Orders Cuts to U.S.-South Korea Military Drills'; 'to cut length, scope'; 'halve joint drills.'

catalysts.title: North Korean missile provocations intensify
catalysts.description: Continued series of North Korean missile launches and barrages in response to diplomacy and drill changes.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'North Korea launches 10 ballistic missiles'; 'missile barrage after dismissing Donald Trump’s overture.'

catalysts.title: Taiwan defence budget increase process
catalysts.description: Taiwan's proposed record boost to its 2027 defence budget and the ensuing budgetary and procurement process.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Taiwan proposes boosting 2027 defence spending 18% to a record high'; 'Taiwan floats record defense budget.'

catalysts.title: China SCS construction push
catalysts.description: Ongoing phases of Chinese construction/works on disputed South China Sea features that alter maritime posture and presence.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'China completes first stage of work at disputed South China Sea reef, images show.'

catalysts.title: South Korean domestic backlash over US moves
catalysts.description: Domestic political pressure and debate in Seoul responding to U.S. drill cuts and pressure, driving coalition and policy responses.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Seoul rattled by Trump’s threat to military drills'; 'South Korea minister says Trump appears to be pressuring Seoul.'

catalysts.title: Russian missile drills affecting regional tensions
catalysts.description: Russian missile exercises that raise tensions with Japan and add to regional great‑power pressure and maritime operations.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Russian Missile Drills Stoke Tensions With Japan.'
